definitions.explanation: A craftsman who forges Japanese swords by folding and hammering steel. A small number still work today under a government license.

examples.japanese: {刀鍛冶|かたなかじ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧。
⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{刀鍛冶|かたなかじ}だった。

{刀鍛冶|かたなかじ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{真|ま}っ{赤|か}→真っ赤：03734_makka⟧な⟦{鉄|てつ}→鉄：02225_tetsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{何度|なんど}→何度：17592_nando⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{打|う}って→打つ：01221_utsu⟧⟦{刀|かたな}→刀：02194_katana⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{仕上|しあ}げて→仕上げる：04664_shiageru⟧いく。
examples.english: The swordsmith beats the red-hot steel again and again to finish the sword.

notes:
⟦{刀|かたな}→刀：02194_katana⟧ (sword) + {鍛冶|かじ} (smith). A swordsmith's finished swords are often named after him, so famous {刀鍛冶|かたなかじ} such as {正宗|まさむね} and {村正|むらまさ} are household names.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {刀鍛冶|かたなかじ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{刀|かたな}→刀：02194_katana⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{打|う}つ→打つ：01221_utsu⟧: a swordsmith forges a sword
- {刀鍛冶|かたなかじ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{弟子入|でしい}り→弟子入り：31434_deshiiri⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to become a swordsmith's apprentice

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{鍛冶屋|かじや}→鍛冶屋：26011_kajiya⟧: blacksmith, who also makes tools
- {刀工|とうこう}: swordsmith, the more formal word
